$comment: Owner ruling 2026-11-01, REFINED same ruling: Obsidian is an AVAILABLE SURFACE — it is a REQUIRED ENTRY in this schema's available-surfaces enumeration (the schema must offer it: see properties.surfaces.items.enum, which contains 'obsidian' by construction and must never lose it). Whether a given profile OBLIGATES Obsidian is that profile's choice (surfaces includes 'obsidian' + the obsidian component is filled), NOT a blanket per-project mandate.
description: A project profile = named scope over the project universe {repos · issue classes · lanes · artifact stores} + the surfaces it binds. Generalizes the llm_map scan profiles ({include,exclude} path-sets) to projects. Design record: docs/ops/ARCHWIZ-CONCEPT-MAP.md (§6 as refined).

encryption.description: Per concept-map matrix §2: encryption attaches to record BODY class; envelope/metadata stays plaintext. Pattern of record: owner-records age store (class-keyed age ciphertext).

key_class.description: age key class when body=age-encrypted (e.g. certifications, user-projects, challenges-notes, decisions)

obsidian.description: The Obsidian component — the project's vault/knowledge surface (design notes, decisions-in-progress, study/term banks, family records). OPTIONAL at profile level: required IFF the profile's surfaces[] includes 'obsidian' (see allOf), with vault+mode then mandatory. Fleet surface of record: bin/obsidian_server.py.

canvas.description: optional: the project's Obsidian canvas (concept map) file inside the vault

folder.description: required in practice when mode=vault-folder: the folder path inside the shared vault

mode.description: vault-root = the project owns a whole vault; vault-folder = a declared folder inside a shared vault; linked = an external vault linked read/write by reference

sync.description: repo-mirrored = vault content mirrored into the repo; local-only = device vault only; server = served via bin/obsidian_server.py

templates.description: optional: vault template notes the project instantiates (task notes, decision notes, study cards)

vault.description: vault name or repo-relative vault path the project declares as its knowledge home

scope.description: The profile's universe subset. Mirrors the scan-profile algebra (include/exclude); every axis may be empty only when the class genuinely has none.

artifact_stores.description: artifact surfaces (Pages/Vercel paths, ops/ dirs, releases)

exclude.description: explicit out-of-scope patterns; MUST carry the scope-safety rule (secret-shaped names: *key*, .npmrc*, tokens) inherited from mapper.json

issue_classes.description: issue labels/forms/classes this project owns (e.g. project-task scope labels)

sr.description: OPTIONAL declaration slot — the profile declares its spaced-repetition POLICY here; the scheduler ENGINE is shared (py-fsrs agent core + ts-fsrs UX per owner rulings 2026-10-30; SM-2 = legitimate baseline) and is NOT implemented per profile. Corpus defaults to the profile's Obsidian vault when it obligates that surface (term banks, study notes, flagged sections) — the reason the SR rulings travel with the Obsidian surface.

corpus.description: obsidian = review items derive from the profile's vault (presupposes surfaces includes 'obsidian' — enforced in allOf); external = a named non-vault corpus (then name it in corpus_ref)

surfaces.description: The surfaces this profile binds. THE ENUMERATION IS THE REQUIREMENT'S HOME: 'obsidian' is a REQUIRED ENTRY of this enum (owner ruling 2026-11-01 as refined) — the schema must always OFFER Obsidian; each profile then chooses its own set. Including 'obsidian' obligates the obsidian component (allOf).

title: Project Profile (ArchWiz concept map, S2 family)
